stable.notes: A polished default character. Miles Windu V4 ships as the bundled pet: rebuilt meditation frames, corrected anatomy, the aura kept inside safe margins, and body scale and baseline normalised across all ten states — no frame in any pose is clipped at its edge now. The pet gallery gains a Restore row to put the shipped character back, and asks first, since it replaces an installed pack. Running stays a burst rather than a treadmill, with settled beats rotating through every solo sequence. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
